ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) base with high-contrast localized white clusters; approximate 80:20 dark-to-light distribution across the visible fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity circular white spots concentrated on the mid-to-lateral left lobe; diffuse white region extending from the peduncle junction into the lower-central right lobe; scattered high-intensity pixels across the trailing edges.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped notch approximately 40 degrees, centered symmetrically at the peduncle insertion point.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serrations; notable large-scale indentation on the inner trailing edge of the left lobe; jagged, high-amplitude peaks at both distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong upward convexity on both lobes, terminating in sharp, tapered lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense cluster of approximately 15-20 distinct circular white high-contrast spots (rosettes) on the left lobe; smaller, sparser circular clusters on the right lobe surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two prominent, nearly vertical parallel white linear marks on the inner left lobe; fine, multi-directional light-grey linear scratching network across the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent vertical white parallel scars on left lobe; extensive circular scarring across the entire fluke surface consistent with barnacle detachment sites.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique high-density 'dotted' pattern on the left lobe creating a distinctive high-contrast spatial signature.
